description: This Java file defines MalformedJsonExceptionMapper, an ExceptionMapper implementation that handles MalformedJsonException thrown during JSON parsing, converting it into an HTTP 400 response with a structured error message.

classes.name: MalformedJsonExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class that implements ExceptionMapper to handle MalformedJsonException exceptions, mapping them to an HTTP 400 response with a JSON error message.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a MalformedJsonException into an HTTP Response with status 400 and a JSON body describing the error.
